criteria.text: Identifies that the Eskdale Energy plc contract (Clause 14.2) allows termination on a change of control without consent, that the disclosure against Warranty 6.3 says there is no such provision, and that consent should be obtained as a condition to Closing.

Identifies that the core platform was developed by contractor Corrib Engineering Ltd without a written IP assignment, so the Company may not own it, and recommends obtaining a confirmatory assignment as a condition to Closing.
Calculates the long-stop date as 12 June 2026 (120 days after signing on 12 February 2026) and identifies that expected clearance on 27 July 2026 falls after it, recommending an extension.
Lists the Eskdale Energy plc change-of-control consent as a required third-party consent and states it has not been obtained.
Gives the long-stop period as 120 days and as the date 12 June 2026, with days remaining from 3 March 2026 (101 days).
Gives a pinpoint citation (document name and section/clause number) for every issue or finding.
